from __future__ import annotations
from typing import Any
from dataclasses import dataclass


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class UserLoggedInData:
    email: str
    flowcatalyst_claims: dict[str, Any]
    login_method: str
    user_id: str
    federated_claims: dict[str, Any] | None = None
    identity_provider_code: str | None = None

    @classmethod
    def from_dict(cls, data: dict[str, Any]) -> UserLoggedInData:
        return cls(
            email=data.get("email"),
            flowcatalyst_claims=data.get("flowcatalystClaims"),
            login_method=data.get("loginMethod"),
            user_id=data.get("userId"),
            federated_claims=data.get("federatedClaims"),
            identity_provider_code=data.get("identityProviderCode"),
        )

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "email": self.email,
            "flowcatalystClaims": self.flowcatalyst_claims,
            "loginMethod": self.login_method,
            "userId": self.user_id,
            "federatedClaims": self.federated_claims,
            "identityProviderCode": self.identity_provider_code,
        }
